statements.status_notes: Advisory GHSA-qjx8-664m-686j reports js-cookie versions up to and including 3.0.5 with no upstream fix released; the version bundled into the Grafana Alloy UI assets shipped in this image is 2.2.1, within the affected range. The library is present as a transitive dependency. Assessment of reachability in Alloy's UI runtime is pending an upstream fix.
